operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israeli Strikes Kill Two Palestinians, Hit Hospital Supply Warehouse in Gaza
heroSubtitle: On Day 1048 (Aug 24, 2026), IDF strikes killed 2 Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah overnight, one an Oct 7 Nukhba fighter. On Day 1047 (Aug 23), Netanyahu and Katz warned the IDF would 'intensify strikes' and evacuate areas over kites launched from Gaza landing near Nahal Oz; separate IAF strikes killed Hamas weapons-production commander Ismail Abu Ful in Maghazi camp and a 4-year-old boy in Az-Zawayda near an aid site, while Israel raised concerns about Hamas disarmament provisions in the ceasefire deal framework. On Day 1046 (Aug 22), an Israeli drone strike killed Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion commander Sharif al-Hasanat and Hamas said it is not obligated to implement the Trump Gaza deal absent Israel's formal acceptance. Gaza's death toll has reached 73,419+ since Oct 7, 2023, including 1,285+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect. Disarmament talks remain at an impasse.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News, Arab News, Al-Monitor, Jerusalem Post, UPI. Gaza death toll: 73,419+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023; 1,285+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. Day 1048 (Aug 24): IDF strikes kill 2 Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah, 1 an Oct 7 Nukhba fighter. Day 1047 (Aug 23): Netanyahu/Katz threaten intensified strikes over Gaza kites near Nahal Oz; IAF kills Hamas cmdr Abu Ful in Maghazi and a 4-yr-old in Az-Zawayda near an aid site; Khan Younis shelled along Yellow Line; Israel raises disarmament concerns. Day 1046 (Aug 22): Drone strike kills Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion cmdr Sharif al-Hasanat; Hamas says not obligated to implement Trump deal without Israeli acceptance. Day 1045 (Aug 21): Poland summons Israeli ambassador over dropped WCK probe; IDF shoots Palestinian crossing Yellow Line in southern Gaza. Day 1044 (Aug 20): Mass funeral in Gaza City for 50 Palestinians (19 children) recovered from Dec 2023 strike rubble; Australia anger over dropped WCK case. Day 965 (Jun 2): IDF drones strike Jabalia, Al-Zawayda, Al-Bureij; 2 killed, 40 wounded in 24-hr period; new Mossad chief Gofman takes over; AP analysis confirms ceasefire hollow — Israel controls 60% of Gaza, Phase 2 paralyzed. Day 964 (Jun 1): IDF strikes continue; Hamas warns dangerous escalation. Day 963 (May 31): Apache strike Gaza seaport cafe — 2 killed, 12 wounded. Day 962 (May 30): Israeli strike kills Palestinian doctor, wounds 3. Day 961 (May 29): Netanyahu 70% Gaza directive. Day 960 (May 28): IDF strikes Gaza City residential building — 10 killed including 4 children. UNRWA staff killed: 397.
